svg.title: Full encoder-decoder macro flow with cross-attention fanning to every decoder block
svg.desc: Source text flows through six sequential encoder blocks producing a final encoder output. Target text flows through six sequential decoder blocks, and the same final encoder output is fed as keys and values into the cross-attention of every single decoder block, not just the first. The last decoder block feeds a linear and softmax layer that predicts the next word.
svg.text: Final encoder output feeds Keys & Values into cross-attention in every decoder block — computed once, reused 6 times
